mapper.sql: SELECT k.id, k.user_id, k.embed_store_id, k.embed_model_id, k.name, k.description, k.cover, k.create_time, u.username, s.name AS embed_store_name, m.name AS embed_model_name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM aigc_docs d WHERE d.knowledge_id = k.id) AS doc_count, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(d.file_size), 0) FROM aigc_docs d WHERE d.knowledge_id = k.id) AS total_size FROM aigc_knowledge k LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON k.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN aigc_embed_store s ON k.embed_store_id = s.id LEFT JOIN aigc_model m ON k.embed_model_id = m.id
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM aigc_knowledge WHERE embed_store_id = #{embedStoreId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO aigc_knowledge (id, user_id, embed_store_id, embed_model_id, name, description, cover, create_time) VALUES (#{id}, #{userId}, #{embedStoreId}, #{embedModelId}, #{name}, #{description}, #{cover}, #{createTime})
